Hallie Hill Animal Sanctuary, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit in South Carolina, provides a safe haven for animals who have nowhere else to go. We focus on preparing animals for adoption through respite, rehabilitation, and socialization. For those with reduced chances of adoption due to age, medical needs, or emotional challenges, we offer a loving Forever Home with proper shelter, nutrition, and medical care. We can’t change an animal’s past, but we can rewrite its future.

By working closely with local shelters and rescues, Hallie Hill helps Charleston maintain its status as a No-Kill Community, welcoming dogs and cats that might otherwise be overlooked. Every animal here matters, and every day is a second chance.
